about.title: About StackKit DevStudio
about.missionText: StackKit DevStudio was built to provide software engineers, QA analysts, and students with a modern, fast, and secure developer workstation. We replace cluttered, insecure online utilities with a unified interface housing 40+ client-side tools.
about.securityText: Unlike conventional online utilities that send your data, JSON payloads, and tokens to remote backend servers, StackKit executes 100% of its functions in your local browser using the native Web Cryptography API. Your data never leaves your device.
about.standardsText: All utilities adhere strictly to published specifications: RFC 7519 for JWT, RFC 8259 for JSON, RFC 4648 for Base64, and official regulatory algorithms including Receita Federal fiscal standards and CNJ Resolution 65/2008 for lawsuit identifiers.
